summary_ja: デルタ・プラス法によるオプション取引等のマーケット・リスク相当額を、デルタの取扱い、ガンマ・リスク、ベガ・リスクに分けて定める。
summary_en: Prescribes the delta-plus method, covering the treatment of delta and the calculation of gamma risk and vega risk.
paragraphs: Where the delta-plus method set forth in Article 276, item (ii) is used, the market risk equivalent amount for option transactions, etc. shall be the total of the market risk equivalent amounts for gamma risk prescribed in item (ii) and vega risk prescribed in item (iii), and delta shall be treated as prescribed in item (i): (i) With respect to the treatment of delta, the amount obtained by multiplying the position in the underlying asset of each option transaction by delta shall be deemed to be a notional position in each risk category under Subsection 2 through the preceding Subsection, and the market risk equivalent amount shall be calculated in the same manner as for other transactions; (ii) The method of calculating the market risk equivalent amount for gamma risk shall be as prescribed below: (a) For each option transaction, etc., the gamma impact shall be calculated by the following formula. Gamma impact = 1/2 × gamma × VU^{2} (VU: the value calculated by the calculation method prescribed in the lower column of the following table according to the category of underlying asset set forth in the upper column of the table.) {{T:p413t0}}; (b) The total of the absolute values of those negative amounts among the totals, for each group of option transactions, etc. with the same underlying asset, of the gamma impact calculated by the formula in (a) shall be the market risk equivalent amount relating to gamma risk; (c) In calculating gamma risk and vega risk under the following item, and in using the scenario method of Article 280, those positions relating to option transactions, etc. set forth in (1) through (3) below that satisfy the respective conditions prescribed therein may be deemed to have the same underlying asset: (1) Debt instruments, etc. and interest rates: the time bands in the table in Article 272-5, item (ii)(a) (or the table in item (ii)(b) of that Article where the duration method is used) corresponding to the residual maturity, etc. are the same, and the currency is the same; (2) Equities, etc.: the country is the same; (3) Foreign exchange: the combination of currencies is the same; (iii) For vega risk, vega shall be calculated for each option transaction, etc. and totaled for each group of option transactions, etc. with the same underlying asset, and the market risk equivalent amount relating to that vega risk shall be the amount obtained by totaling the absolute values of those negative amounts among the amounts obtained by aggregating, for each group of option transactions, etc. with the same underlying asset, the assumed changes in value where the volatility of the price of the underlying asset moves up and down by 25% from the level as of the calculation reference date.
